scripts.model: node dev/decode-meshopt.mjs dev/tripo-source.glb /tmp/wooden-fish-plain.glb && blender -b --python dev/clean-model.py -- /tmp/wooden-fish-plain.glb /tmp/wooden-fish.glb && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.5.1 draco /tmp/wooden-fish.glb assets/wooden-fish.glb --encode-speed 0 --decode-speed 5
scripts.relics: python3 -I dev/fetch-blenderkit.py ~/.cache/fundev-blenderkit && blender -b --disable-autoexec --python dev/build-relics.py -- ~/.cache/fundev-blenderkit /tmp/wooden-fish.glb /tmp/relics.glb && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.5.1 draco /tmp/relics.glb assets/relics.glb --encode-speed 0 --decode-speed 5
scripts.voice: uv run --with numpy --with soundfile python dev/chant-voice.py
